text:
diana: quick sync  ACME-Appliance goes GA next month and marketing wants a joint announcement + promotional credits in marketplace. partner ops asked how promo credits map to entitlements and billing reconciliation.
samir: key constraints: marketplace handles purchase/entitlement, our ledger is authoritative for usage. promo credit must be represented as an entitlement override row so partner billing can net it.
josh: for appliance customers we often see bursty egress during install windows which can push provisional estimates high. need explicit rule how promos apply to provisional vs final.
priya: proposal: issue a promo_entitlement with negative unit_price_cents (credit) scoped to customer_id and sku. show it as separate ledger row type: "PROMO_CREDIT" with ledger_row_id and fingerprint. promo should apply at finalization, but provisional feeds include a preview row flagged provisional=true.
marketplace-bot: Created task MP-7001  appliance-promo-entitlement-spec (assignee: samir).
finance: we need sample payloads and downstream accounting guidance. also tax treatment might differ; legal pls advise.
legal: tax note: credits reduce taxable revenue in most jurisdictions, but partner invoice practices vary. include a clause that credits are applied post-finalization and partners are responsible for local tax treatment.
diana: example promo ledger row (provisional) to include in partner preview feed:
```json
{"ledger_row_id":"lr-promo-20261001-0001","customer_id":"cust-ACME-AP-1","sku":"appliance-ingress","period_start":"2026-10-01T00:00:00Z","period_end":"2026-10-31T23:59:59Z","usage_units":0,"unit_price_cents":-100000,"provisional":true,"reason":"LAUNCH_PROMO","confidence":0.95,"generated_at":"2026-10-02T05:00:00Z","fingerprint":"<hmac-hex>"}
```
samir: operational rules: 1) promo entitlements are visible in both provisional webhook and nightly CSV; 2) credits are applied only when ledger finalizes; 3) if partner disputes promo eligibility within dispute window we hold credit until resolution.
josh: reconciliation edge: what if appliance gets trial customers that convert to paid mid-cycle? need to prorate promo usage. recommend promo rows include applied_units and max_applicable_units to make math clear.
priya: updated promo payload example for proration: ```json
{"ledger_row_id":"lr-promo-20261001-0002","customer_id":"cust-ACME-AP-1","sku":"appliance-ingress","period_start":"2026-10-01T00:00:00Z","period_end":"2026-10-31T23:59:59Z","applied_units":20000,"max_applicable_units":50000,"unit_price_cents":-2,"provisional":true}
```
finance: track applied_units in CSV export so partner can match to their device counters. include fingerprint and ledger_row_id. we also want an audit trail for manual overrides.
legal: include requirement that partner provides signed promotion agreement before credits are issued. add clause for clawback if fraud detected.
diana: partner asked for a webhook event when promo credit flips from provisional->final with change_reason. include change_reason enum values: BACKFILL, ELIGIBILITY_ADJ, MANUAL_ADJ, PROMO_EXPIRY.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: MP-7001 milestone due in 5 business days.
samir: technical: add promo fields to ledger schema: promo_code, applied_units, max_applicable_units, promo_metadata (freeform). promo_metadata must be small (<=1024 chars) and sanitized.
josh: deploy playbook: 1) preview feed emits promo provisional row 2) partners reconcile nightly csv 3) finalization runs and emits PROMO_CREDIT final row 4) notification webhook: {"event":"promo_finalized","ledger_row_id":...,"fingerprint":...}
priya: sample finalized webhook body: ```json
{"event":"promo_finalized","ledger_row_id":"lr-promo-20261001-0002","customer_id":"cust-ACME-AP-1","applied_units":20000,"amount_cents":-40000,"finalized_at":"2026-11-07T04:00:00Z","fingerprint":"<hmac-hex>","change_reason":"ELIGIBILITY_ADJ"}
```
finance: final question  how to surface promo credits in partner billing CSV? include a promo_type column and negative provisional_amount_cents. also include exported_at_utc and file_checksum.
legal: i'll draft the promo addendum language and sample SOW clause for launch promos.
diana: action items: samir -> spec + schema migration; priya -> webhook + CSV examples; josh -> playbook + ops runbook for prorate; finance -> accounting mapping; legal -> promotion terms. i'll schedule a partner walk-through for next Wed 09:00 PT.
samir: noted. tagging @ACME-marketing once spec is ready. :rocket:
